newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Kimberly-Clark de Mexico.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kimberly-Clark de Mexico.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming Inc said it started coverage of consumer products company Kimberly-Clark de Mexico S.A. with long-term buy rating.
-- Analyst Terry Sigler said the company's reliance on products with inelastic demand, and its low leverage, wide margins and high liquidity make it one of the least risky investment plays in Mexico.

-- He added that Mexico's consumer products market has consistently expanded in excess of GDP growth, should enable Kimberly Clark de Mexico's earnings before interests, taxes, depreciation and amortization to grow 24.4 percent in 1996 and 19.2 percent in 1997.
